title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing adoption spreads in a population under varying policies, social influence, information flows, supply constraints, and disease transmission.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals update mask-wearing decisions based on the observed behavior and norms of their network neighbors and household.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and government enforce mask mandates, potentially issuing fines or denying entry to non-compliant individuals.

interactions.name: retail_purchase
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks from retailers subject to inventory, price, and subsidies.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: Public health messages and misinformation influence risk perception and compliance propensity.

interactions.name: disease_transmission
interactions.description: Infections occur during contacts at locations; mask type and usage reduce transmission probability.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals wearing a mask at each time step.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum fraction of mask-wearers observed during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_target_adoption
metrics.description: Time steps required to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: average_compliance_under_mandate
metrics.description: Mean mask-wearing rate during periods when a mandate is active.

metrics.name: cumulative_masks_sold
metrics.description: Total number of masks sold by retailers over time, as a proxy for supply uptake.

metrics.name: stockout_frequency
metrics.description: Proportion of time steps with zero retailer inventory.

metrics.name: Rt_effective
metrics.description: Estimated effective reproduction number over time, accounting for masking.

metrics.name: cumulative_infections
metrics.description: Total number of infections observed during the simulation.

metrics.name: infections_averted_vs_baseline
metrics.description: Difference in cumulative infections compared to a no-mask or no-policy baseline scenario.

metrics.name: policy_cost
metrics.description: Total cost of subsidies and enforcement actions.

metrics.name: fines_issued
metrics.description: Total fines assessed to non-compliant individuals.

metrics.name: adoption_inequity_index
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption rates across income or demographic groups (e.g., Gini or variance).
